title: Hybrid Belief Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Coordinated Spatial Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2603.03595v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Coordinating multiple autonomous agents to explore and serve spatially heterogeneous demand requires jointly learning unknown spatial patterns and planning trajectories that maximize task performance. Pure model-based approaches provide structured uncertainty estimates but lack adaptive policy learning, while deep reinforcement learning often suffers from poor sample efficiency when spatial priors are absent. This paper presents a hybrid belief-reinforcement learning (HBRL) framework to address this gap. In the first phase, agents construct spatial beliefs using a Log-Gaussian Cox Process (LGCP) and execute information-driven trajectories guided by a Pathwise Mutual Information (PathMI) planner with multi-step lookahead. translated_title: 混合信念强化学习用于高效协同空间探索
translated_abstract: 协调多个自主智能体以探索并服务空间异质的需求，需要同时学习未知的空间模式并规划能最大化任务性能的轨迹。纯基于模型的方法能够提供结构化的不确定性估计，但缺乏自适应策略学习能力；而深度强化学习在缺乏空间先验的情况下往往存在样本效率低下的问题。本文提出了一种混合信念-强化学习（HBRL）框架来填补这一空白。在第一阶段，智能体使用对数高斯考克斯过程（LGCP）构建空间信念，并执行由具有多步前瞻能力的路径互信息（PathMI）规划器引导的信息驱动轨迹。在第二阶段，轨迹控制被转移至一个软演员-评论家（SAC）智能体，并通过双通道知识迁移实现热启动：i) 信念状态迁移提供空间不确定性信息，ii) 经验回放迁移（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出混合信念-强化学习（HBRL）框架，第一阶段利用LGCP空间信念与PathMI多步前瞻规划器进行信息驱动探索，第二阶段通过双通道知识迁移热启动SAC智能体，从而实现多智能体协同空间探索的高效学习与规划。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid belief-reinforcement learning (HBRL) framework that combines LGCP-based spatial belief construction with a multi-step lookahead PathMI planner in the first phase, and dual-channel knowledge transfer to warm-start a SAC agent in the second phase, enabling efficient learning for coordinated multi-agent spatial exploration.
